text:
nora: quick ping - support escalated a case: truncated streaming response -> immediate client retry -> duplicate tool invocation billed.
sam: can you drop the skinny repro?
nora: steps: 1) client starts stream to model X; 2) server sends truncation FIN at token ~1450 (we truncated due to safety/filter); 3) client retries instantly; 4) router routes to fallback shard; 5) toolcall (external HTTP enrichment) fired again. Ledger shows both provisional and confirmed entries.
lee: is session id preserved across the retry? that's usually our dedupe key.
nora: client preserved `X-Session: ember-21` but shard changed because fallback rules prefer lower-latency regional node. dedupe cache is local - second execution happened.
billing-bot: INFO billing: provisional(session=ember-21, id=pc_4f2, tokens=1450)
billing-bot: INFO billing: confirmed(session=ember-21, id=cc_9d0, tokens=1448)
ui-bot: NOTE UI: ledger shows two rows; no automatic refund flag.
sam: short-term UX fix: flag provisional rows with a tooltip "pending reconciliation; may be de-duplicated" and a support action to request expedited review.
lee: long-term options: (A) global dedupe index (expensive), (B) sticky routing window on reconnect, (C) inter-shard dedupe probe before executing side-effecting toolcall.
ops: for availability we hate sync cross-shard calls on the critical path. C seems plausible if best-effort and bounded 50ms timeout. B is attractive too.
nora: proposal: router attaches `X-Prev-Shard` when it detects a reconnect within 20s. receiving shard does a non-blocking RPC to prev shard's dedupe cache with a 40ms deadline. if prev shard returns DUP -> short-circuit toolcall and synthesize deduped response; else proceed.
sam: need to ensure idempotency of toolcalls themselves. if the toolcall isn't idempotent we must block or queue. most of our enrichment calls are read-only, but double-check.
lee: add a toolcall-hash header computed from request payload + tool name. use (session, toolcall-hash) as lookup key.
billing-bot: NOTE billing: provisional entries marked `reconciled=false` until ledger finalizes.
ui-bot: UI story: add a small gray "provisional" pill + link "request refund" which opens ops workflow with trace id. auto-hide duplicate provisional rows if ledger reconciliation webhook marks one as refunded.
ops: acceptance criteria for infra change: 1) no >1% increase in P99; 2) dedupe probe timeout defaults to 40ms; 3) can be toggled per-customer.
sam: rollout plan: enable probe in router for 5% of reconnects for 24h, validate provisional->confirmed delta metric decreases. if safe, ramp.
nora: filed INF-8123 with logs, traces, and suggested probe flow. tagging billing, ui, and ops.
lee: tests: write an e2e that simulates FIN truncation + immediate reconnect to alternate shard and assert single toolcall charged. also unit test dedupe probe timeout behavior.
sam: one more UX note: console should show "route changed on retry" in trace view so support can quickly see why dedupe missed.
ui-bot: will draft copy for provisional tooltip and the refund popup.
nora: thanks — assigned P2. we'll coordinate on the canary next week. :wave:
